content: Azure Application Gateway confidential compute helps organizations protect sensitive data not only in transit, but also while the gateway processes it. By running the Application Gateway data plane in a confidential computing environment, decrypted request and response data receives hardware-backed protection while being inspected and routed. Organizations can extend confidential computing to the application delivery layer while retaining managed capabilities including TLS termination, WAF, Layer 7 routing, Layer 4 proxying, load balancing, and observability. This is particularly useful for confidential web applications, APIs, AI applications, and regulated workloads that require stronger protection for sensitive data in use. The add-on is available for Standard V2 and WAF V2 SKUs. Learn more.
